title: Maximum Product of Word Lengths
description: Given an array of lowercase English strings `words`, return the maximum value of `words[i].length * words[j].length` over all pairs `(i, j)` such that `words[i]` and `words[j]` share no common letters. If no two words are letter-disjoint, return `0`.
constraints: words[i] consists only of lowercase English letters.
hints: Represent the character set of each word as a 26-bit integer mask; two words share no letters if and only if `(mask1 & mask2) == 0`.
Deduplicate identical masks by keeping only the longest word length for each mask before checking pairs.

examples.explanation: Every pair shares at least the letter 'a', so no disjoint pair exists and the answer is 0.
